# effect

## Functions

### runMediaGeneration()

```ts
function runMediaGeneration(
  host,
  request,
  signal?,
): Effect<MediaGenerationOutcome, MediaSettingsError | MediaExecutionError>;
```

Validate, admit, dispatch and save one generation against `host`. Shared by the
`/generate` Hono route and the Agent image tool so both run the exact same
admission, billing and destination-write sequence.
